reviews.x: Item was what I expected. This is the exact gift my daughter wanted.

reviews.t: Save the turtles! Or your budget.
reviews.x: I was drawn to these after seeing an ad on the Insta for something similar, but they wanted like $24 for a single piece. I want to save the turtles, but I also want to do crazy things like eat. So, I found these. They are SUPER soft, and I was doubtful of their makeup removing ability. Until I got one wet. Just with water. And then the magic happened. All but like 7% of my eye makeup came off. I put some eye makeup remover on the pad and the rest came off easily. Then I washed my face with it, a

reviews.t: Great substitute for single use pads
reviews.x: So far I’ve loved these. I’d been looking for a way to decrease single-use items in my home and this was a big one for me. Disposable cotton pads don’t travel well, and I felt like I would frequently run out. These washable ones are very soft and work better in less swipes than a disposable pad. The two tone colors make it easy to avoid stains, and they wash well in the machine. There’s also plenty so I can wash them halfway through so I never run out. Excited to take them with me the next time

I love these reusable makeup remover pads. I was getting so frustrated with the inconsistent quality of the cotton rounds I was buying so I decided to give these a go. So nice! Soft and fluffy, I’ve washed them twice now, just thrown them in with a load of dark colored items, and hung the bag in my laundry room for a day to dry them. Simple! They work perfect with makeup remover or astringent on them. Feel very nice on my skin.

reviews.t: This is the exact same thing as my Halo makeup remover! Wonderful!!
reviews.x: I was a little iffy on these, not really sure if they’d work as well as my Halo BUT I WAS PLEASANTLY SURPRISED! These are amazing! They work great, just with water too. They are durable, soft & they wash up wonderfully. My daughter absolutely loves them & has agreed to let me have half of these that I bought for myself! 😂
I have been very pleased so far. I washed when I received as suggested and have been using these to remove my make-up. They are gentle on my skin. The bag makes it very convenient to wash.
Takes a little bit for it to absorb and actually needs a scrubby side ...the soft side is good
They work! But make sure to wash them. They have black dye that takes forever to rinse out.

I would recommend these to anyone who wears makeup. They are SUPER soft & very generously sized. They don't tug on my lashes like cotton pads did. There are 16 in the package, so enough to use a fresh one every day for 2 weeks. This works out perfectly for me because I wash towels every other week & these go in with my towels. The only "negative" thing I can say is that the bag that comes with the set to wash the pads in isn't large enough in my opinion. But, also in my opinion, you don't really

I bought these to reduce the waste of disposable cotton pads. I love that I can rewatch and reuse them.  But in actually using the pads...I’m underwhelmed. They do feel soft. The black side is useless. It doesn’t remove makeup “with only water” as claimed which I figured was too good to be true. The white side works okay for toner but the absorption is sub par: the toner either sits on top of the material until I rub it in, or soaks through to the black side. It is gentle on my skin, and I like

reviews.t: Easy to use, easy to clean, good on environment
reviews.x: These little pads are super good at removing all the makeup, even eye make up which can be very hard with a make remover wipe, but with this and only water it took it all off, the white side also works well with toner, it's kind of an awkward size to get a good grip, but if you fold it, it helps, also after the toner just rinsing it out works wonders, the laundry bag worked very well, held intact after wash and is a pretty sturdy material for the price, which I love, also using these has already

I love these things, they are much larger than I was expecting them to be. But DANG if they don't get your makeup off, even without face wash or makeup remover. I have very sensitive skin so these are perfect I don't have to use makeup remover to get my face clean. If you take mascara off with them be sure to use the black side or rinse the white side out immediately with some soap. That are super absorbent and even take the oil off my face, make sure to moisturize afterwords or your skin may be

reviews.t: No issues with shipping or the pads, but the washing bag is complete junk...
reviews.x: When I received this, I made sure to read and follow the directions which said to wash the pads using the included washing bag prior to using them on my face. So I put them in the little bag and tossed them in the washing machine. When the cycle was done, I took them out and the bag was completely falling apart. I couldn't believe it it! Definitely disappointing, because I was excited to take advantage of how simple it is to clean these. Guess I'll have to find another bag elsewhere :/

This was a great buy for me since I wear a little bit of makeup everyday. They are very easy to wash I just put them in the bag it comes with and I wash them all together then i let them air dry. I wouldn't recommend them if you wear heavy makeup though bc you would have to use a few of them for one day of makeup. But for soft makeup their are great. I've been trying to talk my friends into buying them. P.s. the makeup will stain them but it doesn't bother me

reviews.t: Works great and good for environment!
reviews.x: I love these for removing makeup! I use with micellar water and it removes makeup well and is super gentle on the skin. Much more gentle on your skin than makeup wipes and also much better for the environment! My only complaint is that they’re pretty thick and absorbent (good quality) so it absorbs a lot of the micellar water so I end up having to use more if it than if I were using disposable cotton rounds. Overall great product!

reviews.t: Great size to remove full face of makeup
reviews.x: These are the perfect size. I like that these are bigger than a lot of other reusable makeup wipes. I use the black side to remove my makeup and the white side to apply toner. This means I no longer need to use dispossable cotton rounds. Great for travelling. The only complaint that I have is that the laundry bag is too small. It doesn't get them clean when you need to wash a bunch of them together.

These have been great to replace disposable cotton pad for most things. I use it for toner or with cream or gel cleanser to exfoliate more. They are very soft. I throw them in with my laundry which I do so frequently it really hasn’t been inconvenient. The black side is great for removing makeup (especially eyeliner or mascara) and the white side for applying toner on a clean face.

I absolutely love these! They were much bigger than I expected, and SO super soft! They almost feel like velvet! They're gentle on my skin, and haven't caused any irritation. Such a perfect alternative to buying single use cotton rounds, when I only use them for toner application, and occasional makeup removing.  Would absolutely recommend!

I love this product. When I first got them, I washed them, and let them air dry. I used them to take off my makeup and put on toner.  And there is so many that they get me through almost two weeks. I like to hand wash them and let them air dry. Very soft, very absorbent and really easy to use

These are great!! I am excited to reduce waste and no longer use the disposable ones! I love how these have 2 sides, one for toners and one for makeup remover. I LOVE the cute washable bag it comes with. So convenient! And you get so many of the pads for a great price. Definitely recommend !

How did I not know about these sooner? I am always looking to save a few pennies... I typically use the disposable pads but they were out so I tried these. Super sized and so soft and easy to launder. I don’t use the bag that comes with, I just throw in the washer with other clothes.

I wanted to finally change my habits of buying the regular cotton pads and I’m so glad I made the decision to buy this. Not only was it affordable but you are saving a ton of money from buying cotton pads. Easy to clean and I will be recommending this to my friends and family!

These are such a nice replacement for cotton pads. The included laundry bag is so nice. I simply use the pad, place it in the bag and every time I run a load of laundry, I simply throw in the bag and they clean so nicely! I'm so impressed and the quality is top notch.

These are bigger than the average pads, which makes them so worth the money! I use them a couple times (because they're so big you can use a different section every time). I love the dark and light side for a clean face or removing makeup. I absolutely love these.

reviews.t: Perfect for my needs. Super soft.
reviews.x: I really love this product!  I have been skeptical about using these because I wanted to use it to remove my eye makeup.  I needed it to be super soft and not scratchy in any way. These are perfect.  Very soft, love the black side for the mascara.

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the pads as very soft, gentle, and comfortable on the skin.
Many reviewers value these as a reusable, eco-friendly alternative to disposable cotton pads.
Several customers say the pads remove makeup effectively, often with just water or micellar water.
Some reviewers complain the black side is useless or that the pads need a scrubby side and don't remove makeup with only water as claimed.
A few customers report issues with the black dye rinsing out and the included washing bag falling apart.
